Sandstone is a Software Development company. Sandstone is an ai-native operating system for in-house legal departments, providing a single platform to manage and resolve legal requests with agents. It unifies legal data, drives end-to-end workflows, and or. Sandstone employs 48 people, founded in 2025. Headquartered in New York, New York, United States, with presence in South Africa.

## About

Sandstone is a comprehensive solution for intake, triage, execution, cataloging, and measurement of legal work, directly in the business tools teams already use.

# Sandstone

Sandstone is a Technology, Information and Internet company. Sandstone is a Los Angeles-based digital agency that builds great products. They operate at the intersection of entrepreneurship, design, and engineering, and their mission is to bring innovative product concepts to life. They focus on making products successful and wear hats - product ma. Sandstone employs 6 people, founded in 2017. Headquartered in Manhattan Beach, California, United States, with an office in Los Angeles.

## About

Sandstone is a Los Angeles-based venture studio and boutique design / development firm. We work with a diverse portfolio of clients ranging from small startups ready to execute on an idea to established companies looking to modernize their brand and technology. Our team has years of expertise earned at some of the world's leading companies and a commitment to building deep relationships with our partners.

Sandstone provides services and consulting in web development, UI / UX / branding design, product management, and startup growth. We often serve as co-founders for new ventures and focus our portfolio on a blend of innovative technology and projects our team is passionate about.
